reading: A top safety researcher at Anthropic has warned AI is advancing so quickly he believes there is a greater than 10% chance it 'could kill all humans' within the next decade.
Evan Hubinger said the risk from current models was 'low' but he was 'worried' the technology might improve itself to pose an existential risk to humanity.
His comments are the latest in a series of increasingly stark warnings about AI, with the debate shifting from whether it truly poses a risk to how big that risk is.
Separately, the Financial Times reported Anthropic withheld its latest model from the UK's AI Safety Institute (AISI), a leading body for assessing AI risk.
Anthropic has declined to comment on the posts by its employees or the situation with the AISI.
Hubinger added: 'I believe Anthropic is trying its best, but we do not yet have a plan to solve alignment for superintelligence and are not clearly on track to.'
Hubinger works in AI alignment, which aims to build human ethical ideas and principles into the technology.
OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta all disclosed hacks carried out by their AI tools.

vocabulary.definition: making progress or moving forward in development; becoming more developed.
relating to existence, especially human existence, or questioning the fundamental nature of something.
very clear, severe, or obvious, often in an unpleasant way.
changing from one position, direction, or opinion to another.
refused to give something or kept something back; past tense of 'withhold'.
politely refused to do something or to comment; past tense of 'decline'.
the state of being in agreement or in a correct or desired position. In AI, it means making systems act in accordance with human values.

entries.ja: 発展や開発において前進すること、またはより発達した状態になること。
entries.ko: 발전하거나 개발이 진전되고 있는 것; 더 발전하게 되는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在发展中取得进展或向前推进；变得更加发达。
entries.es: Haciendo progreso o avanzando en el desarrollo; volviéndose más desarrollado.
entries.pt-BR: Fazendo progresso ou avançando no desenvolvimento; tornando-se mais desenvolvido.

entries.ja: 存在、特に人間の存在に関わる、または何かの根本的な性質を問いかける。
entries.ko: 존재, 특히 인간의 존재와 관련된, 또는 어떤 것의 근본적인 본질에 의문을 제기하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 与存在，特别是人类存在有关，或质疑某事物根本性质的。
entries.es: Relacionado con la existencia, especialmente la existencia humana, o que cuestiona la naturaleza fundamental de algo.
entries.pt-BR: Relativo à existência, especialmente à existência humana, ou que questiona a natureza fundamental de algo.

entries.ja: 非常に明確で、厳しく、または明白なこと。しばしば不快な形で。
entries.ko: 매우 분명하거나, 심각하거나, 명백한, 흔히 불쾌한 방식으로.
entries.zh-Hans: 非常清楚、严峻或明显的，常以一种令人不快的方式。
entries.es: Muy claro, severo u obvio, a menudo de una manera desagradable.
entries.pt-BR: Muito claro, severo ou óbvio, muitas vezes de uma maneira desagradável.

entries.ja: ある位置、方向、または意見から別のものへと変化すること。
entries.ko: 한 위치, 방향 또는 의견에서 다른 것으로 바뀌는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 从一个位置、方向或观点改变到另一个。
entries.es: Cambiando de una posición, dirección u opinión a otra.
entries.pt-BR: Mudando de uma posição, direção ou opinião para outra.

entries.ja: 何かを与えることを拒否した、または何かを差し控えたことを意味する、「withhold」の過去形。
entries.ko: 무언가를 주기를 거부했거나 무언가를 보류했다; 'withhold'의 과거형.
entries.zh-Hans: 拒绝给予某物或扣留某物；“withhold”的过去式。
entries.es: Se negó a dar algo o retuvo algo; tiempo pasado de 'withhold'.
entries.pt-BR: Recusou-se a dar algo ou reteve algo; passado de 'withhold'.

entries.ja: 丁寧に何かをすることやコメントすることを拒否したことを意味する、「decline」の過去形。
entries.ko: 정중하게 무언가를 하는 것을 거부하거나 언급하기를 거부했다; 'decline'의 과거형.
entries.zh-Hans: 礼貌地拒绝做某事或拒绝发表评论；“decline”的过去式。
entries.es: Se negó cortésmente a hacer algo o a comentar; tiempo pasado de 'decline'.
entries.pt-BR: Recusou-se educadamente a fazer algo ou a comentar; passado de 'decline'.

entries.ja: 合意している状態、または正しい、あるいは望ましい位置にある状態。AIにおいては、システムが人間の価値観に従って行動するようにすること。
entries.ko: 동의하거나 올바르거나 원하는 위치에 있는 상태. 인공지능에서는 시스템이 인간의 가치에 따라 행동하도록 만드는 것을 의미합니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 处于一致或处于正确或期望位置的状态。在人工智能中，它意味着使系统按照人类价值观行事。
entries.es: El estado de estar de acuerdo o en una posición correcta o deseada. En IA, significa hacer que los sistemas actúen de acuerdo con los valores humanos.
entries.pt-BR: O estado de estar em acordo ou em uma posição correta ou desejada. Em IA, significa fazer com que os sistemas ajam de acordo com los valores humanos.
